videos.title: How Are Tires Made? (They Used to Be White) 🛞
videos.description:
The first car tires were white. Carbon black made them tougher, and black. Rubber from trees and oil, Charles Goodyear's 1839 stove accident (vulcanization), layers of fabric and steel, and about 10 minutes in a hot mold.
Would you buy white tires today? 👇

videos.title: What If You Fell Into Lava? (Movies Get It Wrong) 🌋
videos.description:
Lava is about three times denser than water, so you wouldn't sink in like in the movies. It's thicker than honey, and the real danger is the heat, over 1,000 °C. That's why volcano scientists wear silver suits that reflect it.
Would you walk near a volcano? 👇
